Why PeakPal

Three pillars of a
safer, greener adventure.

Every feature is designed with the nervous first-timer in mind — removing barriers, reducing risk, rewarding eco-conscious choices.

Risk Intelligence

Real-time navigation continuously monitors trail conditions — auto-detecting landslides, weather shifts, and hazardous crowding — rerouting you before you ever face danger.

⚡ Live hazard detection

Eco-Friendly Rental

Sustainably-sourced, expertly-maintained gear delivered directly to your trailhead at a fraction of retail price. No commitment, no clutter — just adventure, ready to go.

🚴 Delivered to trailhead

Eco-Oasis Gamification

Low-carbon transit choices earn points that unlock lush digital habitats. Adopt a Red Fox, Hedgehog, or Mountain Deer — each acts as your real-time safety companion on every trail.

🦊 Unlock animal pals
Getting started

From first click to first summit — three steps.

01

Choose Your Trail

Browse curated beginner-friendly routes matched to your fitness level and location — every trail safety-verified by our team.

02

Rent Eco Gear

Select sustainable gear and have it waiting at your trailhead — zero hassle, zero environmental footprint, maximum readiness.

03

Hike with Your Pal

Set off with your animal companion in real-time — alerting you to hazards and celebrating every eco-friendly choice you make on the trail.
